svg.title: Saleae Test Automation overview
svg.desc: Extend the Saleae workflow with scheduled recording windows and duration-controlled capture so a marine control and monitoring module can be observed through a PC during performance testing. Flow: Plan test windows; Acquire via API; Analyze transitions; Retain test evidence
